title: Anastasia Labs X MoneyKit - Transaction Manifests & FinTech Platform Integration for Cardano

ms.promise:
Develop a tool to classify Cardano transactions based on smart contract address and datum structure and produce human-readable transaction manifests.
Number of Outputs:
・Code to classify Cardano transactions and produce transaction manifests.
